newsitem.title: USA: Tridex says IRS confirms tax-free spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Tridex says IRS confirms tax-free spin-off.

text.p: Tridex Corp said Wednesday it received a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service confirming the tax-free nature of the proposed distribution of common stock of TransAct Technologies Inc, owned by Tridex.

Tridex owns 5.4 million, or about 80.3 percent, of the outstanding shares of TransAct common stock, which will be distributed on March 31, 1997, to Tridex stockholders of record on March 14, 1997, on the basis of about one share of TransAct common stock for each share of Tridex common stock outstanding.
Seth Lukash, Tridex chairman and chief executive officer, said that the vesting of all options under the Tridex stock plan has been accelerated so that the options are now exercisable.
He added that Tridex soon will call for redemption all of its outstanding convertible debt.

He said that if the holders of all outstanding options, warrants and convertible debt exercise their rights to obtain shares of Tridex common stock, the distribution ratio will be about 1.0044 shares of TransAct for each share of Tridex.
Subsequent to the distribution of the TransAct shares, Tridex will be composed of its Ultimate Technology Corp and Cash Bases GB Ltd subsidiaries and its Tridex Ribbon Division.

Tridex manufactures terminals, cash drawers and other peripheral devices and integrated systems for retail point-of-sale and other transaction-based markets. TransAct Technologies designs, develops, manufactures and markets transaction-based printers and related products.
